key_impacts: Communities in Colorado Springs, including Mountain Shadows, Cedar Heights, and areas from Peregrine to Wolfe Ranch, were affected by the wildfire.
Residential structures were damaged and destroyed, as documented in sections on Damage and Destruction and Destroyed Structures.
First responders conducted defensive actions to prevent structure ignitions and to extinguish damaged structures.
Fire behavior during the event included wind change and spotting, as described in the report’s timelines.
